version.description: Removed required from the dimension measures since unit dropdown isn't working.

props.description: Product is a common data model should be used across Fuuz apps that require product, item, sku level information.

props.label: Code
props.description: A human-readable and unique shorthand name for the product

props.label: Name
props.description:
Human-readable product name using full words

Doesn't strictly have to be unique

props.label: Gtin
props.description: A GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) is a universally recognized identifier for a product. It is globally unique and customer-facing, allowing retailers and online marketplaces to easily identify what is being sold.

props.label: Sku
props.description: An SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) is a company-specific identifier used for internal inventory management

props.label: Upc
props.description: UPC (Universal Product Code) is a specific type of GTIN used in North America

props.label: Shelf Life Days
props.description: Shelf life in calendar days for this product. Default value is 0; no expiration.

editor.elementName: Save Button which saves form data.

props.label: Default Quantity Unit
props.description: The default unit to assign the quantity of inventory of this product

props.label: Barcode Design
props.description: A reference to the document which specifies the barcode format to be used on this product

props.label: Description
props.description: Full description of the product. Usually about a paragraph, depending on the product.
